q: How do I register for an event?
a: Open the event on the Quest Board and press Register. Each event lists its team size, fee and deadline.

q: Can I take part in more than one event?
a: Yes, as long as the timings don't clash. The Schedule shows every event by day and time.

q: Do I need a pass for the pronites?
a: Yes. Pronite entry is through IGNUS passes. See the Passes page for what each pass includes.

q: How do I reach IIT Jodhpur?
a: The campus is on NH 62 (Nagaur Road), outside Jodhpur city. Travel and shuttle details from Jodhpur Junction and Jodhpur Airport will be shared before the fest.
